display.purpose: Workspace and public catalog page headings.

label.purpose: Form labels, table headings, and supporting metadata.

shadows.name: glass-depth
shadows.purpose: Ground glass work panels against the navy page field.

shadows.name: dialog-depth
shadows.purpose: Separate confirmation dialogs from the active workspace.

motion.name: surface-transition
motion.purpose: Short hover and navigation changes; respect reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Turquoise action for the main next step in a form or workflow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 15px; border: 1px solid rgba(168, 246, 233, .42); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); font: 700 12px/1.2 var(--font-sans); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .16s ease, border-color .16s ease, transform .16s ease, backdrop-filter .16s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #83e5d8; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Dark labeled field with a visible focus state for search and form entry.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: var(--text-soft); font: 650 11px/1.4 var(--font-sans); } .ds-input { min-height: 41px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(195,225,232,.22); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: rgba(3,18,31,.52); color: var(--text); font: 400 14px/1.5 var(--font-sans); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent); outline: 2px solid rgba(103,216,203,.24); }

components.name: Glass Panel
components.description: Translucent container for an actual work area, with a visible edge and offset depth.
components.css: .ds-panel { border: 1px solid var(--glass-edge); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--glass); color: var(--text); box-shadow: var(--shadow-glass); backdrop-filter: blur(18px) saturate(135%); } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0; font: 700 16px/1.3 var(--font-sans); } .ds-panel p { margin: 6px 0 0; color: var(--text-soft); font: 400 14px/1.5 var(--font-sans); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Compact text-and-dot state marker; color is never the only signal.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 5px 9px; border: 1px solid rgba(195,225,232,.16); border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(242,250,249,.055); color: #b7cbd2; font: 600 10px/1.2 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chip i { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #f0bd72; }

components.name: Workspace Navigation
components.description: Deep slate rail with a bright turquoise active item to orient staff across CRM modules.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 5px; padding: 12px; background: #071725; color: #b7cbd2; font: 600 12px/1.3 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 8px; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgba(234,250,250,.07); color: #eef6f6; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #67d8cb; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-item.ds-active { background: rgba(103,216,203,.12); color: #67d8cb; }

narrative.overview: A dark, calm CRM workbench uses glass panes to organize real sales and inventory work. Tables stay central, with turquoise reserved for action and focus.
keyCharacteristics: Translucent glass panels with full visible edges
Uzbek Latin interface and text-labeled states

rules.name: The Workbench Rule
rules.body: Keep lead and catalog data as the visual center; glass contains the work instead of replacing rows with cards.

rules.name: The Text-Labeled Status Rule
rules.body: Never communicate a lead stage or inventory state with color alone.

rules.name: The Surface Rule
rules.body: Glass earns its place when it separates a panel from the backdrop or clarifies a modal layer.

dos: Keep controls keyboard reachable and focus visible.
Pair status colors with short labels.
Use glass where it creates real depth.
donts: Do not replace operational tables with repeated icon cards.
Do not use blur as decoration on every element.
Do not expose sale completion as a normal stage selector.
